title: claude-broker base plan decision
description: The orchestrator answers a plan: approve it, amend it, or reject it. Posted to the worker inbox with the same task_id.

task_id.description: Unique task key. Namespaces constrain the format via a manifest extension (e.g. cb-YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>).

to.description: Addressee: a worker name, 'orchestrator', or '*' for broadcast.

subject.description: Headline, readable in the summary projection.

refs.description: Message ids, task_ids, commit shas, URLs.

decision.description: approve = proceed as planned; amend = proceed with amendments; reject = revise and re-plan.

amendments.description: Changes the worker must apply when decision is amend.
